description: Thales (Cinterion) MV32-W, the T99W373 platform (Snapdragon X62) under VID 1e2d, 1e2d:00f4 with cdc_mbim. VID 1e2d is not shared with the Compal prototypes at these IDs. Experimental (the owner, 2026-11-06: «пусть хотя бы инет поднимается»): the internet through ModemManager over MBIM (cdc_mbim binds by its class, no ID table needed), no AT console or radio dialect until a bench (the SDX62's AT set is not the T99W175's), no driver binding; recovery on the operator's request only. Reference only, no bench of ours: QModem's modem_support.json (t99w373: USB mbim and rmnet; Thales mv32-w-a 1e2d:00f1 mbim, mv32-w-b 1e2d:00f2 mbim and rmnet), another modem manager field notes

recovery.source: experimental: reconnect, radio and reset through ModemManager on request; nothing at the USB level until a bench
